newsitem.title: USA: Innovex stake cut by Vinik group.
newsitem.headline: Innovex stake cut by Vinik group.

text.p: A group led by former Magellan Fund manager Jeffrey Vinik said it lowered its stake in Innovex Inc to 5.4 percent or 381,300 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transaction includes the sale of 83,600 common shares between December 3 and December 10 at prices ranging from $41.1231 to $48.8980 per share.
The group previously held a 6.5 percent stake or 464,900 common shares in the Hopkins, Minn.,-based maker of precision electromagnetic products.
